The story is a quiet, atmospheric slice-of-life piece that focuses on the subtle tension between a recently widowed mother (Ilse) and her visiting son (Jonas). While everything that happens is entirely "appropriate" and consistent with the characters and setting, there are no "surprising" narrative turns, plot twists, or thrilling subversions of expectations.
